Our Story

A Peaceful Bamboo Retreat In Wayanad

"Here, the bamboo sways gently, the air carries the scent of earth and rain, and time feels beautifully unhurried."

Nestled in the serene village of Chennalode, Padinjarathara, Edhini Bamboo Grove Resort is a nature-lover's sanctuary where lush bamboo canopies filter morning light into something almost golden. Wake to birdsong, walk barefoot on dewy grass, and rediscover a pace of life the modern world rarely offers.

Our eco-inspired cottages sit within natural bamboo groves, offering a retreat that is both intimate and immersive. Whether you arrive as a couple seeking a romantic escape, a family in search of adventure, or a traveller craving stillness — Edhini holds you gently and sends you home renewed.

Why Edhini

An Experience Unlike Any Other

Every detail at Edhini is crafted to bring you closer to nature while surrounding you with warm, personal hospitality.

Bamboo Forest Ambience

Towering bamboo groves surround every corner of the resort — alive, peaceful, and endlessly restorative. The kind of atmosphere that recalibrates the soul.

Nature-Inspired Stays

Our cottages blend warmth with simplicity — large glass frontages framing the forest, terracotta rooftiles, and wooden steps that ground you in the natural world.

Couple Friendly

A quiet bamboo grove, intimate cottages, and natural beauty that transforms every moment together into something quietly extraordinary.

Family Friendly

From the curved swimming pool with a water slide to the colourful children's play area, families discover endless joy and togetherness in Wayanad's embrace.

Eco Tourism

Nature trails, organic surroundings, and a commitment to sustainable hospitality make Edhini the ideal destination for responsible, mindful travellers.

Photography Spots

Cave art rock installations, bamboo corridors, vivid sunrises, and valley views — Edhini is a photographer's natural studio at every hour of the day.

The Wayanad Experience

Where Every Moment Becomes A Memory

Step into a world where mornings begin with mist rolling over the valley, afternoons are spent in the shade of ancient trees, and evenings glow warm under open skies. Edhini places you at the heart of Wayanad's most authentic beauty.

  • Sunrise walks through bamboo corridors
  • Outdoor dining under a canopy of century-old trees
  • Swimming pool with panoramic valley views
  • Children's play zone and water slides
  • Cave-art inspired outdoor meditation spaces
  • Close to Wayanad's wildlife sanctuaries
  • Authentic Kerala cuisine and warm hospitality
  • Photography-worthy landscapes at every turn
